# Isaiah Chapter 42 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 25 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*First Servant Song; justice to nations; light to Gentiles; new song; blind and deaf servant*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**The Servant of the LORD:** First Servant Song; justice to nations; light to Gentiles; new song; blind and deaf servant. The key message for modern readers: "A bruised reed he will not break, and a faintly burning wick he will not quench"

*-- PNEUMA*
